---
title: "Progression-free survival — unadjusted and adjusted models"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(rstanarm)
library(survival)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "covariates.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "05-progression-free-survival", "results")
imputation_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "imputations")
model_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "models")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

m <- config$imputation$m_supporting
```

## Unadjusted

```{r}
#| label: fit-unadjusted
#| include: false
unadjusted_data <- read_parquet(file.path(results_dir, "prepared.parquet")) |>
  select(id, tx, pfs_time_days, event_pfs)

stopifnot(!anyNA(unadjusted_data), all(unadjusted_data$pfs_time_days > 0))

model_path <- file.path(model_dir, "unadjusted-01.rds")

if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
  model <- stan_surv(
    Surv(pfs_time_days, event_pfs) ~ tx,
    data = unadjusted_data,
    basehaz = "ms",
    basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
    prior = normal(location = 0, scale = 0.55),
    prior_intercept = normal(0, 20),
    prior_aux = dirichlet(1),
    prior_covariance = decov(),
    chains = 4L,
    cores = 4L,
    iter = 2000L,
    warmup = 1000L,
    adapt_delta = 0.99,
    refresh = 0L,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 2300
  )
  saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
}
```

## Adjusted (fixed)

```{r}
#| label: fit-fixed
#| include: false
fixed_datasets <- readRDS(file.path(imputation_dir, "completed-os_adjusted.rds"))

for (index in seq_len(m)) {
  fitting_data <- fixed_datasets[[index]]

  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(fitting_data),
    all(fitting_data$pfs_time_days > 0),
    all(as.integer(as.character(fitting_data$ecog_binary)) ==
          derive_ecog_binary(fitting_data$ecog_fstcnt)),
    all(as.integer(as.character(fitting_data$mgps)) ==
          derive_mgps(fitting_data$albumin, fitting_data$c_reactive_protein))
  )

  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("os_adjusted-%02d.rds", index))
  if (file.exists(model_path)) next

  model <- stan_surv(
    Surv(pfs_time_days, event_pfs) ~ tx + ecog_binary + stage_binary + lung + mgps,
    data = fitting_data,
    basehaz = "ms",
    basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
    prior = normal(location = rep(0, 6), scale = c(0.55, rep(2.5, 5))),
    prior_intercept = normal(0, 20),
    prior_aux = dirichlet(1),
    prior_covariance = decov(),
    chains = 4L,
    cores = 4L,
    iter = 2000L,
    warmup = 1000L,
    adapt_delta = 0.99,
    refresh = 0L,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000 + 2400
  )
  saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
}
```

## Adjusted (hierarchical)

```{r}
#| label: fit-hierarchical
#| include: false
diagnosis_datasets <- readRDS(file.path(imputation_dir, "completed-diagnosis.rds"))

for (index in seq_len(m)) {
  fitting_data <- diagnosis_datasets[[index]]

  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(fitting_data),
    all(fitting_data$pfs_time_days > 0),
    all(as.integer(as.character(fitting_data$ecog_binary)) ==
          derive_ecog_binary(fitting_data$ecog_fstcnt)),
    all(as.integer(as.character(fitting_data$mgps)) ==
          derive_mgps(fitting_data$albumin, fitting_data$c_reactive_protein))
  )

  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("diagnosis-%02d.rds", index))
  if (file.exists(model_path)) next

  model <- stan_surv(
    Surv(pfs_time_days, event_pfs) ~
      tx + ecog_binary + stage_binary + mgps + (1 | diagnosis),
    data = fitting_data,
    basehaz = "ms",
    basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
    prior = normal(location = rep(0, 5), scale = c(0.55, rep(2.5, 4))),
    prior_intercept = normal(0, 20),
    prior_aux = dirichlet(1),
    prior_covariance = decov(),
    chains = 4L,
    cores = 4L,
    iter = 2000L,
    warmup = 1000L,
    adapt_delta = 0.99,
    refresh = 0L,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000 + 2500
  )
  saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
}
```
